(rule!
 (let ((dummy 0))
   (define (anti-transpose-grid grid) (rotate-180 (transpose grid)))
   (define (apply-transform-name name grid)
     (cond ((equal? name 'id) grid)
           ((equal? name 'rot90) (rotate-cw grid))
           ((equal? name 'rot180) (rotate-180 grid))
           ((equal? name 'rot270) (rotate-ccw grid))
           ((equal? name 'flip-h) (flip-lr grid))
           ((equal? name 'flip-v) (flip-ud grid))
           ((equal? name 'transpose) (transpose grid))
           (else (anti-transpose-grid grid))))
   (define (e8-cell<? a b)
     (or (< (first a) (first b))
         (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
   (define (e8-norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) e8-cell<?))
   (define (e8-cells->grid cells)
     (let* ((norm (e8-norm cells)) (bb (bbox-of-cells norm)))
       (if (not bb)
           (list (list 0))
           (paint-cells (empty-grid (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb)) 0) norm 1))))
   (define (e8-grid-shape grid)
     (e8-norm
      (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
              (grid-positions grid))))

     (e8-grid-shape (apply-transform-name name (e8-cells->grid cells))))

     (cond ((equal? name 'rot90) (list (second p) (- maxr (first p))))
           ((equal? name 'rot180) (list (- maxr (first p)) (- maxc (second p))))
           ((equal? name 'flip-h) (list (first p) (- maxc (second p))))
           ((equal? name 'flip-v) (list (- maxr (first p)) (second p)))

          (cells (filter (lambda (p)
                           (and (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0))

          (color (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells))))
